textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
local itemTitle = store:buybackName()
component("textPadding"):SetInt(3*game.menuScaleX())
if(store:Category() == game.StoreCategories_TYPE_CURRENCY and element:parent():name() ~= "freeDiamonds") then component("size"):SetFloat(0.25*game.menuScaleY()) component("yOffset"):SetInt(-6*game.menuScaleY()) else component("size"):SetFloat(0.3*game.menuScaleY()) end
component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01)
if((string.match(itemTitle, "%s") == nil) or (store:Category() == game.StoreCategories_TYPE_CURRENCY)) then component("multiline"):SetInt(0) else component("multiline"):SetInt(1) end
component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED) component("text"):SetString("'"..itemTitle.."'") component("layer"):SetString("HUD")

aeComponent.name: Sprite
aeComponent.event:
local entityId = store:buybackEntityId()
local monsterId = store:buybackMonsterId() local monsterData = game.getMonsterData(monsterId)
local animFile = game.monsterTypeGfxName(monsterId) local animName = game.entityAnimName(entityId) --isin't this always "Store"??
if monsterData:isModal() then local currentMode = game.player():getActiveIsland():islandMode() modalMonsterData = game.getModalMonsterData(monsterData, currentMode)
local buyback = store:getBuyback() if buyback then if not buyback:isModeActivated(currentMode) then --show the ghost animFile = monsterData:animationFile() if currentMode == 1 then animName = "Store_MIN" end else
animFile = modalMonsterData:animationFile() end else animFile = modalMonsterData:animationFile() end end
component("animationName"):SetString("xml_bin/" .. animFile)
local scale = 0.7*game.menuScaleX()
if store:buybackIsActiveBoxMonster() or store:buybackIsEvolvedMonster() then
if game.isWubboxType(monsterId) then scale = 0.2*game.menuScaleX() elseif game.isUnderlingIsland() then scale = 0.6*game.menuScaleX() end
local animUtil = game.AnimUtil(component) local hasActivateAnim = animUtil:hasAnimation("Activate")
component("animation"):SetString("Store")
-- Wublins and Celestials have activate animations - if the monster has an activate and hasn't evolved from anything, use it's activate if hasActivateAnim and monsterData:evolvedFrom() == 0 then
scale = 0.4*game.menuScaleX() component("animation"):SetString("Activate") component("pingpong"):SetInt(1) element:setOrientationPosition(lua_sys.Vector2(0, 48*game.menuScaleX()))
end
else component("animation"):SetString(animName) end
local equippedCostume = store:buybackEquippedCostume() game.applyCostumeToAnimComponent(component, equippedCostume)
component:setScale(lua_sys.Vector2(scale,scale)) component("layer"):SetString("HUD")

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component("multiline"):SetInt(0) component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.4*game.hudScale()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED)
if(game.isAmberIsland() and store:Category() == game.StoreCategories_TYPE_MONSTER) then game.StoreContext_setRelicTextColour(component) else if game.isEtherealIsland() then game.StoreContext_setEtherealTextColour(component) else local monsterId = store:buybackMonsterId() local monsterData = game.getMonsterData(monsterId) if(not monsterData:isAstralDipster()) then game.StoreContext_setCoinTextColour(component) else game.StoreContext_setKeyTextColour(component) end end end
component("text"):SetString(game.commaizeNumber(store:BuybackCost())) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1) component("layer"):SetString("HUD")

spriteSheetComponent.name: Sprite
spriteSheetComponent.event: if(game.isAmberIsland() and store:Category() == game.StoreCategories_TYPE_MONSTER) then component("spriteName"):SetString(game.StoreContext_SPRITE_RELIC) else local monsterId = store:buybackMonsterId() local monsterData = game.getMonsterData(monsterId) if(not monsterData:isAstralDipster()) then component("spriteName"):SetString(game.coinsSpriteImgForThisIsland()) else component("spriteName"):SetString(game.StoreContext_SPRITE_KEY) end end component("sheetName"):SetString(game.StoreContext_CURRENCY_SPRITESHEET) component("size"):SetFloat(0.3*game.menuScaleX()) component("layer"):SetString("HUD")

ninesliceComponent.name: Sprite
ninesliceComponent.event: component("topHeight"):SetFloat(50.0) component("bottomHeight"):SetFloat(50.0) component("leftWidth"):SetFloat(50.0) component("rightWidth"):SetFloat(50.0) component("includeBorder"):SetInt(1) component("size"):SetFloat(0.3*game.menuScaleX()) component("spriteName"):SetString("gfx/menu/Black9SFrame50") component("layer"):SetString("HUD")
